cases.title: C native suite
cases.inputs: Task-owned native worker subprocesses; local deterministic TCP origin; no external services or real credentials.
procedure: Execute forwarding unit regressions, then all real native functional cases, before formal timing.
Reset a fresh worker group for each trial; use fixed warm artifact and reverse state order on alternate trials.
Assert exact bytes and retained generation state, preserve every raw sample, then close streams and wait for worker OS exit.

oracle.method: External client exact expected bytes and manager identity/phase assertions.
oracle.assertion: All real worker native integration cases pass, including controller disconnection with live streams, centralized revocation, source silent worker deadline, TLS/WS/SSH, retained capacity and bad native preflight.
oracle.independence: Clients construct expected payloads without calling forwarding code; OS process and stable authority checks are separate from child forwarding.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: Both generations retain live TLS/WebSocket streams, original CA/custom roots and one contiguous resident audit sequence.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: Authenticated SSH channels continue across worker switch using unchanged MITM host identity.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: Four retained old workers keep all streams; extra prepare is refused and natural drain releases capacity.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: Control disconnection preserves granted streams, normal EOF and central revocation; final OS exit releases parent leases.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: Confirmed candidate crash permits rollback of future dispatch while prior generation stream survives.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: A source child that never reads large bootstrap cannot escape the whole-phase 30s send deadline.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: A Booted child that stops consuming controls is quarantined by the 30s health deadline and retired.

verifications.trigger: The named real subprocess integration test reaches its specified boundary.
verifications.assertion: With zero target Hosts, bad native ABI cannot publish global stable deployment or change installed target/active worker.

verifications.trigger: The named source regression executes its controlled fault or state transition.

verifications.trigger: The named source regression executes its controlled fault or state transition.
verifications.assertion: Control loss immediately releases ungranted offer claims, preserves granted cancellation watchers, and remains idempotent.

verifications.trigger: The named source regression executes its controlled fault or state transition.

protocol.timing_boundary: For each echo, immediately before client write to complete read of 256 bytes; byte assertion follows timestamp. Throughput spans barrier release through final successful task completion.
protocol.warmup: Eight clients each perform32 untimed exchanges; actual untimed byte oracle runs before all timed traffic. Prepare is explicitly warm-artifact.
protocol.reset: Fresh task-owned worker group and local origin each trial; held old streams enforce target state.

sampling.basis: Five independent worker groups per state are an explicit local development budget, informed by 20-scenario pilot; request samples are correlated within trials. No production power or P99 claim.

protocol.accounting: Unique logical work only:5 upgrade operations,5120 echoes or160 admissions by case. Errors terminate scenario and make run invalid; no retry.

cases.title: Actual Windows inherited stdio cancellation
cases.inputs: Native Windows process with actual Command::piped parent handles; existing source silent worker; exact-source CI evidence when measurements execute on Linux.
procedure: Run the real inherited stdio cancellation unit on native Windows and assert both read and write return within five seconds while the child stays alive.
Run all twelve native worker subprocess regressions, including unchanged bootstrap deadline and control-loss cancellation/drain assertions.
When the local performance run is Linux, preserve pending Windows records until the exact-source successful Windows job is bound with its full log and metadata.

oracle.method: Native OS child liveness, operation completion channels, unchanged phase budgets and independently validated worker flows.
oracle.assertion: Both overlapped operations finish before any handle or buffer is released, the peer remains alive after shutdown, and all twelve native worker cases pass.
oracle.independence: A source child never reads stdin; parent completion and OS child liveness are checked separately. GitHub metadata and committed source hashes bind external Windows evidence.

verifications.trigger: The native Windows real ChildStdin/ChildStdout regression and corresponding actual worker case execute at the exact bound product source commit.
verifications.assertion: Actual native Windows ChildStdout read cancellation completes without waiting for the live child to exit; granted streams still drain and central cancellation remains effective.

verifications.trigger: The native Windows real ChildStdin/ChildStdout regression and corresponding actual worker case execute at the exact bound product source commit.
verifications.assertion: Actual native Windows ChildStdin write cancellation completes while the silent child remains alive; the complete bootstrap phase retains its 30-second deadline.

limitations: Project native hooks, installer, resident durable journal, cold artifact and all-platform execution remain outside this component benchmark.
Five process trials and fixed offered work cannot establish production tail latency, maximum throughput or long-term memory leak absence.
Controller resources include local origin and test harness; sampled1ms peaks can miss transient threads.
Known-cost and wrong-byte sensitivity mutations will be run in isolated source copies; their results are reported separately.
Unix descriptor-exhaustion verification is not observed on Windows; its formal valid-coverage report must retain that gap until an equivalent native fault test exists.

Windows overlapped inherited stdio read/write boundaries remain mandatory. Linux samples do not observe them: retain a blocked Windows record until exact-source native CI metadata and complete logs establish both cancellation directions and all twelve worker subprocess cases.

preconditions: Built final CLI or source worker probe matching frozen sources; Rust/Cargo and local compiler available.
Native resource collection on Linux or Windows; task-owned files and loopback sockets only.
cleanup: Close clients; mark workers draining and wait for confirmed child OS exit; remove only task-owned fixture directories.
